# #4669: Patch: the authenticator code as six boxes
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

The authenticator app's 6-digit code (two-step sign-in, R665) is typed into a plain text box today. It should be drawn as **six boxes, one per digit**, the way most sign-in screens draw a one-time code (GitHub, Stripe, Apple and the like), in the tavern theme the invite code's boxes already wear.

Where a two-step code is asked for:

- `/login`'s two-step step (`mode === "mfa"`): the `login-code` input in `apps/web/src/routes/login.tsx` (around line 1320), shown with "Code from your authenticator app".
- `/account`'s enrolment, after the QR code: the `account-two-step-code` input in `apps/web/src/auth/TwoStepSettings.tsx` (around line 206).

**Reuse `CodeField`; do not build six inputs.** `apps/web/src/auth/CodeField.tsx` (R191, §9.4) already draws the invite code as boxes over ONE real input, with transparent text and `aria-hidden` segments, so paste, autofill (`autocomplete="one-time-code"`), undo and screen readers keep working. That is the pattern the well-known OTP widgets use too (input-otp/shadcn, Bootstrap's OTP input, Cloud Four's write-up): six separate inputs lose SMS and keychain autofill, partial paste and undo, and a screen reader reads them as six unlabeled fields. Give `CodeField` a second format and draw the two-step code with it:

- A digits format: alphabet `0-9`, length 6, one digit per box (group size 1, no separator), as a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9). R104's alphabet leaves out `0` and `1`, which a TOTP code needs, so this format is its own. Where the invite and room formats are defined (`crates/server/src/config.rs`, through `@jackioh/server-config`), or the shared config, is the planner's call. `net/auth.ts`'s `TOTP_CODE_PATTERN` (`/^[0-9]{6}$/`) should come from the same constant, so the two cannot disagree.
- Numeric keyboard on phones (`inputMode="numeric"`), focused when the step opens (as `login-code` is today), and a pasted `123 456` or `123-456` filling all six boxes.
- `CodeField`'s refusal messages talk about the invite alphabet's left-out characters. For the digits format a letter should be refused with a sentence about digits, not about `0`, `1`, `I` and `O`.
- The look: the invite field's boxes (`apps/web/src/auth/code-field.css`, the `index.css` tokens, scoped under `.code-field`), at six columns, with the caret box highlighted and filled boxes in the gold/brass of `tavern.css`. It has to fit a phone's width at `/login` and `/account` with no horizontal scroll.

The email code on `/login` (R664) shares the `login-code` input but runs 6 to 10 digits (`EMAIL_CODE_PATTERN`), so it keeps the plain field. Only the second-factor step changes. `apps/admin`'s sign-in (`SignIn.tsx`) is out of scope.

§9.4 says the invite code "is typed into one field drawn as four groups" and says nothing of the two-step code's field, so this needs a ruling (CLAUDE.md rule 3): the two-step code is one field drawn as six boxes, read as digits only.

### Acceptance

- At `/login`'s two-step step and `/account`'s enrolment, the code is one `<input>` with `autocomplete="one-time-code"` and `inputmode="numeric"`, drawn as six `aria-hidden` boxes, with the existing test ids (`loginTestid.code`, `twoStepTestid.code`) still on the input.
- Typing, pasting `123456`, `123 456` or `123-456`, and Backspace each fill or clear the boxes in order. A letter is refused and named, with a digits sentence. A seventh digit is refused.
- `TOTP_CODE_PATTERN` and the field's format come from one named constant.
- The email code field on `/login` is unchanged.
- A new ruling note in this issue's block, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`, a one-sentence §9.4 addition, and a test named after it in `CodeField.test.tsx` or `TwoStepSettings.test.tsx`. `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

None.
